page.layout: Running head at top centre; two printed columns of text: a narrow left margin column of italic notes, and a central column of consul names with years in the right margin of that column, with bracketed remarks in the column; a partial line "Lodewijch" at the foot of the column, cut off by the page edge.

note.i: Noua illa mœ-nium forma eodem in latere consumꝫ[?] mata.
Academia auspicijs Ill. & Potentiū Groningæ & Omlandiæ Ord: aperta, solenni ritu introdu-cta a. d. x. Kal. Sept. Rectore primo Ubbone Emmio.

page.notes: Years 1611–1617 are printed in the right margin of the consul column, each beside the second or third name of its block; placed here as cells on the matching line. Bracketed remarks "[non sedit.]" and "[obijt x Nouembris anno aetatis XLIX.]" are printed in the column in italic. The top-left note's last word ("consumꝫ mata") is hard to read; the abbreviation may stand for consummata, so it is marked [?]. The final line "Lodewijch" is cut off at the foot and continues beyond the page edge. Faint show-through from the reverse side appears on the left and is not transcribed.
